get_neighbors_nvidia: build a python module to find nearest atomic neighbors using NVIDIA nvalchemiops with periodic boundary conditions and a cutoff radius
radius_graph_pbc_nvidia: build a python module to generate a radius graph with PBC support using NVIDIA accelerated neighbor search
get_neighbors_nvidia_atoms: build a python module to find nearest neighbors for an ASE Atoms object using NVIDIA nvalchemiops and return distances
review_get_neighbors_nvidia: review the get_neighbors_nvidia function to understand how it handles batched inputs and degeneracy tolerance for max neighbors
refactor_radius_graph_pbc_nvidia: refactor the radius_graph_pbc_nvidia function to support a different neighbor search method or custom PBC tensor
